newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 18-month and 24-month CCTs.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 18-month and 24-month CCTs.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for 200 billion lire of 18-month variable-rate certificates (CCT) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 322 billion lire of paper, and also bid for 326 billion lire of 24-month paper against an offer of 200 billion lire.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 3.719 trillion lire of 18-month CCTs at the open auction for the October 15 1998 paper, against two trillion lire worth of certificates on offer.
The auction price was set at 91.80 from 91.45 at the previous CCT sale on May 12.
Also in the auction, the Treasury received bids for 3.886 trillion lire of 24-month CCTs at the open auction against two trillion lire on offer.
The auction price was set at 88.55 from 88.15 at the previous CCT sale.
